_comment: The default heavy operation types (design D26, H-107). One heavy job runs at a time across the run. The orchestrator may add a type for one run with 'harness slot <run> heavy-add'; it can never raise a limit. Browser and UI checks are a stage with their own limit (stage:browser), not a heavy type.

ops.covers: container image builds: docker build, docker buildx build, docker compose build, compose up --build
starting or restarting a multi-container stack (app and database) without a build
npm, pnpm or yarn install, pip install, poetry install, bundle install, cargo fetch
production compiles and bundles: npm run build, next build, vite build, full tsc, cargo build --release
a whole unfiltered test suite, such as npm test, pytest or tests/run-all.sh
database migrations from zero, seeding, dump and restore
